revision.comment: 新しいページ：甲塚古墳（栃木県下野市にある古墳）。
revision.text:
{{日本の古墳 |名称 = 甲塚古墳 |画像 = [[File:Kabutozuka Kofun (Shimotsuke) zenkei.JPG|280px]]
墳丘全景（右に後円部、左に前方部） |所属 = |所在地 = [[栃木県]][[下野市]]国分寺847 |緯度度 = 36|緯度分 = 23|緯度秒 = 1.80 |経度度 =139|経度分 = 48|経度秒 = 18.15 |ISO = JP-09 |形状 = [[帆立貝形古墳]] |規模 = 墳丘長80m |築造年代 = [[6世紀]]後半 |埋葬施設 = [[横穴式石室]] |被葬者 = |出土品 = [[埴輪]]片・土器片 |史跡指定 = なし |特記事項 = |地図=Japan Tochigi |ラベル = 甲塚古墳 |アイコン = |ラベル位置 = top }} '''甲塚古墳'''（かぶとづかこふん）は、[[栃木県]][[下野市]]国分寺にある[[古墳]]。形状は[[帆立貝形古墳]]。史跡指定はされていない[http://www.shimotsuke-bunkazai.com/culturalassets.php?id=45 甲塚古墳]（下野市文化財バーチャルミュージアム）。。 == 概要 ==
{| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff;text-align:center;font-size:85%;" |+栃木県南部の主要古墳の築造順{{Sfn|甲塚古墳出土埴輪（下野市）}} !代!!古墳名!!形状!!墳丘長 |- |1||[[摩利支天塚古墳]]||前方後円墳||120m |- |2||[[琵琶塚古墳]]||前方後円墳||123m |- |3||[[吾妻古墳]]||前方後円墳||128m |- |4||'''甲塚古墳'''||帆立貝形古墳||80m |- |5||国分寺愛宕塚古墳||前方後円墳||78.5m |- |6||山王塚古墳||前方後円墳||72m |- |7||丸塚古墳||円墳||65m |}
栃木県南部、[[下野市]]西部の[[姿川]]と[[思川 (栃木県)|思川]]に挟まれた台地上に築造された古墳である。一帯では、本古墳のほかにも[[摩利支天塚古墳]]・[[琵琶塚古墳]]・[[吾妻古墳]]を始めとする大型古墳群の分布が知られる。本古墳では[[1883年|1883]]・[[1893年]]（[[明治]]16・26年）に発掘され旧状が損なわれているほか、考古学的にはこれまでに数次の発掘調査が実施されている。 墳丘は帆立貝形で、前方部を南方に向ける史跡説明板。。墳丘は2段築成で、墳丘長は推定で約80メートル、主丘（ほぼ円形）は直径61メートルを測る。墳丘第1段には幅の広い平坦面（基壇）が形成され、その平坦面の中央部には[[円筒埴輪]]列が巡らされている。また第2段のくびれ部付近において[[形象埴輪]]（人物形・馬形埴輪など）が検出されており、特に埴輪群の位置・向きが良好に遺存する点、全国で初となる機織形埴輪2点の点、および一部の埴輪に彩色の残る点で注目される{{Sfn|甲塚古墳出土埴輪（下野市）}}。主体部の埋葬施設は[[凝灰岩]]製の[[横穴式石室]]で、前方部前面に開口し、全長4.2メートルを測る。以上より、築造年代は[[古墳時代]]後期の[[6世紀]]後半頃と推定される。 [[2017年]]（[[平成]]29年）には、文化審議会により出土埴輪群の国の[[重要文化財]]への指定が答申されている（官報告示を経て正式指定となる）[http://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/2017031002.html 国宝・重要文化財（美術工芸品）の指定について]（文化庁ホームページ）。。なお付近では、隣接して後世に[[下野国分寺跡|下野国分寺]]が営まれている。 == 埋葬施設 == 埋葬施設には[[凝灰岩]]の切石による[[横穴式石室]]が使用されている。現在までに損壊を受けているが、復原推定される石室の規模は次の通り。 * 石室全長：4.2メートル - 墓道を含めると約9メートル * 玄室 ** 長さ：3.0メートル ** 幅：2.0メートル ** 高さ：1.9メートル * 羨道 ** 長さ：0.6メートル == 脚注 == {{脚注ヘルプ}} {{reflist}} == 参考文献 == {{small|（記事執筆に使用した文献）}} * 史跡説明板（下野市教育委員会設置） * {{Wikicite|reference={{PDFlink|[http://www.city.shimotsuke.lg.jp/ct/other000011200/kohunn9-2.pdf 甲塚古墳]}}（下野市ホームページ）|ref={{Harvid|甲塚古墳（下野市）}}}} * {{Wikicite|reference={{PDFlink|[http://www.city.shimotsuke.lg.jp/ct/other000024600/kabutotukasyutudohaniwarejyume.pdf 甲塚古墳出土埴輪]}}（下野市ホームページ）|ref={{Harvid|甲塚古墳出土埴輪（下野市）}}}} * {{Wikicite|reference={{PDFlink|[http://www.city.shimotsuke.lg.jp/ct/other000024600/kabutotukahataorigatahaniwa.pdf 甲塚古墳出土機織形埴輪]}}（下野市ホームページ）|ref={{Harvid|甲塚古墳出土機織形埴輪（下野市）}}}} == 関連文献 == {{small|（記事執筆に使用していない関連文献）}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2005|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 栃木県国分寺町 平成16年度規模確認調査|publisher=栃木県国分寺町教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=とちぎ未来づくり財団埋蔵文化財センター編|author=|year=2012|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 重要遺跡範囲確認調査（栃木県埋蔵文化財調査報告 第343集）|publisher=栃木県教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2014|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 下野国分寺跡史跡整備関連発掘調査報告書（下野市埋蔵文化財調査報告 第11集）|publisher=下野市教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} == 関連項目 == * [[下野国分寺跡]] == 外部リンク == * [http://www.shimotsuke-bunkazai.com/culturalassets.php?id=45 甲塚古墳] - 下野市文化財バーチャルミュージアム {{DEFAULTSORT:かふとつかこふん しもつけし}} [[Category:栃木県の古墳]] [[Category:下野市の歴史]] [[Category:帆立貝形古墳]]

墓道を含めると約9メートル * 玄室 ** 長さ：3.0メートル ** 幅：2.0メートル ** 高さ：1.9メートル * 羨道 ** 長さ：0.6メートル == 脚注 == {{脚注ヘルプ}} {{reflist}} == 参考文献 == {{small|（記事執筆に使用した文献）}} * 史跡説明板（下野市教育委員会設置） * {{Wikicite|reference={{PDFlink|[http://www.city.shimotsuke.lg.jp/ct/other000011200/kohunn9-2.pdf 甲塚古墳]}}（下野市ホームページ）|ref={{Harvid|甲塚古墳（下野市）}}}} * {{Wikicite|reference={{PDFlink|[http://www.city.shimotsuke.lg.jp/ct/other000024600/kabutotukasyutudohaniwarejyume.pdf 甲塚古墳出土埴輪]}}（下野市ホームページ）|ref={{Harvid|甲塚古墳出土埴輪（下野市）}}}} * {{Wikicite|reference={{PDFlink|[http://www.city.shimotsuke.lg.jp/ct/other000024600/kabutotukahataorigatahaniwa.pdf 甲塚古墳出土機織形埴輪]}}（下野市ホームページ）|ref={{Harvid|甲塚古墳出土機織形埴輪（下野市）}}}} == 関連文献 == {{small|（記事執筆に使用していない関連文献）}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2005|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 栃木県国分寺町 平成16年度規模確認調査|publisher=栃木県国分寺町教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=とちぎ未来づくり財団埋蔵文化財センター編|author=|year=2012|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 重要遺跡範囲確認調査（栃木県埋蔵文化財調査報告 第343集）|publisher=栃木県教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2014|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 下野国分寺跡史跡整備関連発掘調査報告書（下野市埋蔵文化財調査報告 第11集）|publisher=下野市教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} == 関連項目 == * [[下野国分寺跡]] == 外部リンク == * [http://www.shimotsuke-bunkazai.com/culturalassets.php?id=45 甲塚古墳] - 下野市文化財バーチャルミュージアム {{DEFAULTSORT:かふとつかこふん しもつけし}} [[Category:栃木県の古墳]] [[Category:下野市の歴史]] [[Category:帆立貝形古墳]]

墳丘全景（右に後円部、左に前方部） |所属 = |所在地 = [[栃木県]][[下野市]]国分寺847 |緯度度 = 36|緯度分 = 23|緯度秒 = 1.80 |経度度 =139|経度分 = 48|経度秒 = 18.15 |ISO = JP-09 |形状 = [[帆立貝形古墳]] |規模 = 墳丘長80m |築造年代 = [[6世紀]]後半 |埋葬施設 = [[横穴式石室]] |被葬者 = |出土品 = [[埴輪]]片・土器片 |史跡指定 = なし |特記事項 = |地図=Japan Tochigi |ラベル = 甲塚古墳 |アイコン = |ラベル位置 = top }} '''甲塚古墳'''（かぶとづかこふん）は、[[栃木県]][[下野市]]国分寺にある[[古墳]]。形状は[[帆立貝形古墳]]。史跡指定はされていない[http://www.shimotsuke-bunkazai.com/culturalassets.php?id=45 甲塚古墳]（下野市文化財バーチャルミュージアム）。。出土品は国の[[重要文化財]]に指定されている。 == 概要 ==
{| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff;text-align:center;font-size:85%;" |+栃木県南部の主要古墳の築造順{{Sfn|甲塚古墳出土埴輪（下野市）}} !代!!古墳名!!形状!!墳丘長 |- |1||[[摩利支天塚古墳]]||前方後円墳||120m |- |2||[[琵琶塚古墳]]||前方後円墳||123m |- |3||[[吾妻古墳]]||前方後円墳||128m |- |4||'''甲塚古墳'''||帆立貝形古墳||80m |- |5||[[国分寺愛宕塚古墳]]||前方後円墳||78.5m |- |6||山王塚古墳||前方後円墳||72m |- |7||丸塚古墳||円墳||65m |}
栃木県南部、[[下野市]]西部の[[姿川]]と[[思川 (栃木県)|思川]]に挟まれた台地上に築造された古墳である。台地上では、本古墳のほかにも[[摩利支天塚古墳]]・[[琵琶塚古墳]]・[[吾妻古墳]]を始めとする大型古墳の分布が知られる。本古墳では[[1883年|1883]]・[[1893年]]（[[明治]]16・26年）に発掘され旧状が損なわれているほか、考古学的にはこれまでに数次の発掘調査が実施されている。 墳丘は帆立貝形で、前方部を南方に向ける史跡説明板。。墳丘は2段築成で、墳丘長は推定で約80メートル、主丘（ほぼ完全な円形）は直径61メートルを測る。墳丘第1段には幅の広い平坦面（基壇）が形成され、その平坦面の中央部には[[円筒埴輪]]列が巡らされている。また第2段のくびれ部付近において[[形象埴輪]]（人物形・馬形埴輪など）が検出されており、特に埴輪群が当初の位置・向きまで良好に遺存する点、[[2004年]]に全国で初となる機織形埴輪2点の出土の点、および一部の埴輪に彩色の残る点で注目される{{Sfn|甲塚古墳出土埴輪（下野市）}}読売新聞栃木版 2017年8月14日 20面。。主体部の埋葬施設は[[凝灰岩]]製の[[横穴式石室]]で、前方部前面に開口し、全長4.2メートルを測る。以上より、築造年代は[[古墳時代]]後期の[[6世紀]]後半頃と推定される。 出土品は[[2017年]]（[[平成]]29年）に国の[[重要文化財]]に指定された。なお付近では、後世に[[下野国分寺跡|下野国分寺]]が隣接して営まれている。 == 埋葬施設 == 埋葬施設には[[凝灰岩]]の切石による[[横穴式石室]]が使用されている。現在までに損壊を受けているが、推定復原される石室の規模は次の通り。 * 石室全長：4.2メートル - 墓道を含めると約9メートル * 玄室 ** 長さ：3.0メートル ** 幅：2.0メートル ** 高さ：1.9メートル * 羨道 ** 長さ：0.6メートル == 文化財 == === 重要文化財（国指定） === * 栃木県甲塚古墳出土品 一括（考古資料） - 内訳は以下。下野市立しもつけ風土記の丘資料館保管。2017年（平成29年）9月15日指定平成29年9月15日文部科学省告示第117号。[http://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/2017031002.html 国宝・重要文化財の指定について]（文化庁）。。 ** 機織形埴輪 2点 ** 人物埴輪 17点 ** 馬形埴輪 4点 ** 須恵器 58点 ** 土師器 16点 ** （附指定）埴輪残欠 4点 == 関連施設 == * 下野市立しもつけ風土記の丘資料館（下野市国分寺） - 甲塚古墳出土品等を保管。 == 脚注 == {{脚注ヘルプ}} {{reflist}} == 参考文献 == {{small|（記事執筆に使用した文献）}} * 史跡説明板（下野市教育委員会設置） * {{Wikicite|reference={{PDFlink|[http://www.city.shimotsuke.lg.jp/manage/contents/upload/5821824673c0f.pdf 甲塚古墳出土埴輪]}}（下野市ホームページ）|ref={{Harvid|甲塚古墳出土埴輪（下野市）}}}} * {{Wikicite|reference={{PDFlink|[http://www.city.shimotsuke.lg.jp/manage/contents/upload/5821824666a85.pdf 甲塚古墳出土機織形埴輪]}}（下野市ホームページ）|ref={{Harvid|甲塚古墳出土機織形埴輪（下野市）}}}} == 関連文献 == {{small|（記事執筆に使用していない関連文献）}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2005|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 栃木県国分寺町 平成16年度規模確認調査|publisher=栃木県国分寺町教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=とちぎ未来づくり財団埋蔵文化財センター編|author=|year=2012|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 重要遺跡範囲確認調査（栃木県埋蔵文化財調査報告 第343集）|publisher=栃木県教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2014|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 下野国分寺跡史跡整備関連発掘調査報告書（下野市埋蔵文化財調査報告 第11集）|publisher=下野市教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} == 関連項目 == * [[下野国分寺跡]] == 外部リンク == * [http://www.shimotsuke-bunkazai.com/culturalassets.php?id=45 甲塚古墳] - 下野市文化財バーチャルミュージアム {{DEFAULTSORT:かふとつかこふん しもつけし}} [[Category:栃木県の古墳]] [[Category:下野市の歴史]] [[Category:帆立貝形古墳]] [[Category:栃木県の重要文化財]]

甲塚古墳出土品等を保管。 == 脚注 == {{脚注ヘルプ}} {{reflist}} == 参考文献 == {{small|（記事執筆に使用した文献）}} * 史跡説明板（下野市教育委員会設置） * {{Wikicite|reference={{PDFlink|[http://www.city.shimotsuke.lg.jp/manage/contents/upload/5821824673c0f.pdf 甲塚古墳出土埴輪]}}（下野市ホームページ）|ref={{Harvid|甲塚古墳出土埴輪（下野市）}}}} * {{Wikicite|reference={{PDFlink|[http://www.city.shimotsuke.lg.jp/manage/contents/upload/5821824666a85.pdf 甲塚古墳出土機織形埴輪]}}（下野市ホームページ）|ref={{Harvid|甲塚古墳出土機織形埴輪（下野市）}}}} == 関連文献 == {{small|（記事執筆に使用していない関連文献）}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2005|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 栃木県国分寺町 平成16年度規模確認調査|publisher=栃木県国分寺町教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=とちぎ未来づくり財団埋蔵文化財センター編|author=|year=2012|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 重要遺跡範囲確認調査（栃木県埋蔵文化財調査報告 第343集）|publisher=栃木県教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2014|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 下野国分寺跡史跡整備関連発掘調査報告書（下野市埋蔵文化財調査報告 第11集）|publisher=下野市教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} == 関連項目 == * [[下野国分寺跡]] == 外部リンク == * [http://www.shimotsuke-bunkazai.com/culturalassets.php?id=45 甲塚古墳] - {{日本の古墳 |名称 = 甲塚古墳 |画像 = [[File:Kabutozuka Kofun (Shimotsuke) zenkei.JPG|280px]]
墳丘（右に後円部、左に前方部） |所属 = |所在地 = [[栃木県]][[下野市]]国分寺847 |緯度度 = 36|緯度分 = 23|緯度秒 = 1.80 |経度度 =139|経度分 = 48|経度秒 = 18.15 |ISO = JP-09 |形状 = [[帆立貝形古墳]] |規模 = 墳丘長80m |築造時期 = [[6世紀]]後半 |埋葬施設 = [[横穴式石室]] |被葬者 = |出土品 = [[埴輪]]片・土器片 |史跡 = なし |有形文化財 = 出土品（国の[[重要文化財]]） |特記事項 = |地図=Japan Tochigi |ラベル = 甲塚古墳 |アイコン = |ラベル位置 = top }} '''甲塚古墳'''（かぶとづかこふん）は、[[栃木県]][[下野市]]国分寺にある[[古墳]]。形状は[[帆立貝形古墳]]。史跡指定はされていない[http://www.shimotsuke-bunkazai.com/culturalassets.php?id=45 甲塚古墳]（下野市文化財バーチャルミュージアム）。。出土品は国の[[重要文化財]]に指定されている。 == 概要 ==
{| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff;text-align:center;font-size:85%;" |+栃木県南部の主な古墳{{Sfn|甲塚古墳出土埴輪（下野市）}} ! !!古墳名!!形状!!墳丘長 |- |1||[[摩利支天塚古墳]]||前方後円墳||120m |- |2||[[琵琶塚古墳]]||前方後円墳||123m |- |3||[[吾妻古墳]]||前方後円墳||128m |- |4||'''甲塚古墳'''||帆立貝形古墳||80m |- |5||[[国分寺愛宕塚古墳]]||前方後円墳||78.5m |- |6||山王塚古墳||前方後円墳||72m |- |7||丸塚古墳||円墳||65m |}
栃木県南部、[[下野市]]西部の[[姿川]]と[[思川 (栃木県)|思川]]に挟まれた台地上に築造された古墳である。台地上では、本古墳のほかにも[[摩利支天塚古墳]]・[[琵琶塚古墳]]・[[吾妻古墳]]を始めとする大型古墳の分布が知られる。本古墳では[[1883年|1883]]・[[1893年]]（[[明治]]16・26年）に発掘がなされ旧状が損なわれているほか、考古学的にはこれまでに数次の発掘調査が実施されている。 墳丘は前方部が短小な帆立貝形の前方後円形で、前方部を南方向に向ける史跡説明板。。墳丘は2段築成。墳丘長は推定約80メートル、主丘（ほぼ完全な円形）は直径61メートルを測る。墳丘第1段には幅の広い平坦面（基壇）が形成され、その平坦面の中央部には[[円筒埴輪]]列が巡らされる。また第2段のくびれ部付近において[[形象埴輪]]（人物形・馬形埴輪など）が検出されており、特に埴輪群は当初の位置・向きまで良好に遺存する点、全国初の機織形埴輪の出土の点、一部の埴輪に彩色の残る点で注目される{{Sfn|甲塚古墳出土埴輪（下野市）}}読売新聞栃木版 2017年8月14日 20面。。埋葬施設は[[凝灰岩]]製の[[横穴式石室]]で、前方部前面において南方向に開口する。築造時期は[[古墳時代]]後期の[[6世紀]]後半頃と推定される。 出土品は[[2017年]]（[[平成]]29年）に国の[[重要文化財]]に指定された。付近では、後世に[[下野国分寺跡|下野国分寺]]が隣接して営まれている。 == 埋葬施設 == 埋葬施設としては[[凝灰岩]]製切石による[[横穴式石室]]が構築されており、前方部全面において南方向に開口する。現在までに損壊を受けているが、推定復原される石室の規模は次の通り。 * 石室全長：4.2メートル - 墓道を含めると約9メートル。 * 玄室 ** 長さ：3.0メートル ** 幅：2.0メートル ** 高さ：1.9メートル * 羨道 ** 長さ：0.6メートル == 文化財 == === 重要文化財（国指定） === * 栃木県甲塚古墳出土品 一括（考古資料） - 明細は以下。下野市立しもつけ風土記の丘資料館保管。2017年（平成29年）9月15日指定平成29年9月15日文部科学省告示第117号。[http://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/2017031002.html 国宝・重要文化財の指定について]（文化庁）。{{国指定文化財等データベース|201|00011756|栃木県甲塚古墳出土品}}。 ** 機織形埴輪 2点 ** 人物埴輪 17点 ** 馬形埴輪 4点 ** 須恵器 58点 ** 土師器 16点 ** （附指定）埴輪残欠 4点 == 関連施設 == * 下野市立しもつけ風土記の丘資料館（下野市国分寺） - 甲塚古墳出土品等を保管・展示。 == 脚注 == {{脚注ヘルプ}} {{reflist}} == 参考文献 == {{small|（記事執筆に使用した文献）}} * 史跡説明板（下野市教育委員会設置） * {{Wikicite|reference={{PDFlink|[http://www.city.shimotsuke.lg.jp/manage/contents/upload/5821824673c0f.pdf 甲塚古墳出土埴輪]}}（下野市ホームページ）|ref={{Harvid|甲塚古墳出土埴輪（下野市）}}}} * {{Wikicite|reference={{PDFlink|[http://www.city.shimotsuke.lg.jp/manage/contents/upload/5821824666a85.pdf 甲塚古墳出土機織形埴輪]}}（下野市ホームページ）|ref={{Harvid|甲塚古墳出土機織形埴輪（下野市）}}}} == 関連文献 == {{small|（記事執筆に使用していない関連文献）}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2005|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 栃木県国分寺町 平成16年度規模確認調査|publisher=栃木県国分寺町教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=とちぎ未来づくり財団埋蔵文化財センター|author=|year=2012|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 重要遺跡範囲確認調査（栃木県埋蔵文化財調査報告 第343集）|publisher=栃木県教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2014|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 下野国分寺跡史跡整備関連発掘調査報告書（下野市埋蔵文化財調査報告 第11集）|publisher=下野市教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} == 関連項目 == * [[下野国分寺跡]] == 外部リンク == * {{国指定文化財等データベース|201|00011756|栃木県甲塚古墳出土品}} * [http://www.shimotsuke-bunkazai.com/culturalassets.php?id=45 甲塚古墳]、[http://www.shimotsuke-bunkazai.com/culturalassets.php?id=61 甲塚古墳出土遺物] - 下野市文化財バーチャルミュージアム {{DEFAULTSORT:かふとつかこふん しもつけし}} [[Category:栃木県の古墳]] [[Category:下野市の歴史]] [[Category:帆立貝形古墳]] [[Category:栃木県の重要文化財]]

栃木県南部、[[下野市]]西部の[[姿川]]と[[思川 (栃木県)|思川]]に挟まれた台地上に築造された古墳である。台地上では、本古墳のほかにも[[摩利支天塚古墳]]・[[琵琶塚古墳]]・[[吾妻古墳]]を始めとする大型古墳の分布が知られる。本古墳では[[1883年|1883]]・[[1893年]]（[[明治]]16・26年）に発掘がなされ旧状が損なわれているほか、考古学的にはこれまでに数次の発掘調査が実施されている。 墳丘は前方部が短小な帆立貝形の前方後円形で、前方部を南方向に向ける史跡説明板。。墳丘は2段築成。墳丘長は推定約80メートル、主丘（ほぼ完全な円形）は直径61メートルを測る。墳丘第1段には幅の広い平坦面（基壇）が形成され、その平坦面の中央部には[[円筒埴輪]]列が巡らされる。また第2段のくびれ部付近において[[形象埴輪]]（人物形・馬形埴輪など）が検出されており、特に埴輪群は当初の位置・向きまで良好に遺存する点、全国初の機織形埴輪の出土の点、一部の埴輪に彩色の残る点で注目される{{Sfn|甲塚古墳出土埴輪（下野市）}}読売新聞栃木版 2017年8月14日 20面。。埋葬施設は[[凝灰岩]]製の[[横穴式石室]]で、前方部前面において南方向に開口する。築造時期は[[古墳時代]]後期の[[6世紀]]後半頃と推定される。 出土品は[[2017年]]（[[平成]]29年）に国の[[重要文化財]]に指定された。付近では、後世に[[下野国分寺跡|下野国分寺]]が隣接して営まれている。 == 埋葬施設 == 埋葬施設としては[[凝灰岩]]製切石による[[横穴式石室]]が構築されており、前方部前面において南方向に開口する。現在までに損壊を受けているが、推定復原される石室の規模は次の通り。 * 石室全長：4.2メートル - 墓道を含めると約9メートル。 * 玄室：長さ3.0メートル、幅2.0メートル、高さ1.9メートル * 羨道：長さ0.6メートル == 文化財 == === 重要文化財（国指定） === * 栃木県甲塚古墳出土品 一括（考古資料） - 明細は以下。下野市立しもつけ風土記の丘資料館保管。2017年（平成29年）9月15日指定平成29年9月15日文部科学省告示第117号。[http://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/2017031002.html 国宝・重要文化財の指定について]（文化庁）。{{国指定文化財等データベース|201|00011756|栃木県甲塚古墳出土品}}。 ** 機織形埴輪 2点 ** 人物埴輪 17点 ** 馬形埴輪 4点 ** 須恵器 58点 ** 土師器 16点 ** （附指定）埴輪残欠 4点 == 関連施設 == * 下野市立しもつけ風土記の丘資料館（下野市国分寺） - 甲塚古墳出土品等を保管・展示。 == 脚注 == {{脚注ヘルプ}} {{reflist}} == 参考文献 == {{small|（記事執筆に使用した文献）}} * 史跡説明板（下野市教育委員会設置） * {{Wikicite|reference={{PDFlink|[http://www.city.shimotsuke.lg.jp/manage/contents/upload/5821824673c0f.pdf 甲塚古墳出土埴輪]}}（下野市ホームページ）|ref={{Harvid|甲塚古墳出土埴輪（下野市）}}}} * {{Wikicite|reference={{PDFlink|[http://www.city.shimotsuke.lg.jp/manage/contents/upload/5821824666a85.pdf 甲塚古墳出土機織形埴輪]}}（下野市ホームページ）|ref={{Harvid|甲塚古墳出土機織形埴輪（下野市）}}}} == 関連文献 == {{small|（記事執筆に使用していない関連文献）}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2005|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 栃木県国分寺町 平成16年度規模確認調査|publisher=栃木県国分寺町教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=とちぎ未来づくり財団埋蔵文化財センター|author=|year=2012|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 重要遺跡範囲確認調査（栃木県埋蔵文化財調査報告 第343集）|publisher=栃木県教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2014|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 下野国分寺跡史跡整備関連発掘調査報告書（下野市埋蔵文化財調査報告 第11集）|publisher=下野市教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} == 関連項目 == * [[下野国分寺跡]] == 外部リンク == * {{国指定文化財等データベース|201|00011756|栃木県甲塚古墳出土品}} * [http://www.shimotsuke-bunkazai.com/culturalassets.php?id=45 甲塚古墳]、[http://www.shimotsuke-bunkazai.com/culturalassets.php?id=61 甲塚古墳出土遺物] - [[ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 埴輪群.JPG|thumb|250px|right|{{center|埴輪群（国の[[重要文化財]]）}}{{small|しもつけ風土記の丘資料館展示（他画像も同様）。}}]] 栃木県南部、[[下野市]]西部の[[姿川]]と[[思川 (栃木県)|思川]]に挟まれた台地上に築造された古墳である。台地上では、本古墳のほかにも[[摩利支天塚古墳]]・[[琵琶塚古墳]]・[[吾妻古墳]]を始めとする大型古墳の分布が知られる。本古墳では[[1883年|1883]]・[[1893年]]（[[明治]]16・26年）に発掘がなされ旧状が損なわれているほか、考古学的にはこれまでに数次の発掘調査が実施されている。 墳丘は前方部が短小な帆立貝形の前方後円形で、前方部を南方向に向ける史跡説明板。。墳丘は2段築成で、特に1段目は平坦な基壇状を呈し、下野地域特有の「下野型古墳」の特徴を示す。墳丘長は推定約80メートル、主丘（ほぼ完全な円形）は直径61メートルを測る。墳丘第1段の平坦面中央部には[[円筒埴輪]]列が巡らされる。また第2段のくびれ部付近において[[形象埴輪]]（人物形・馬形埴輪など）が検出されており、特に埴輪群は当初の位置・向きまで良好に遺存する点、全国初の機織形埴輪の出土の点、一部の埴輪に彩色の残る点で注目される{{Sfn|甲塚古墳出土埴輪（下野市）}}読売新聞栃木版 2017年8月14日 20面。。埋葬施設は[[凝灰岩]]製の[[横穴式石室]]で、前方部前面において南方向に開口する。築造時期は[[古墳時代]]後期の[[6世紀]]後半頃と推定される。 出土品は[[2017年]]（[[平成]]29年）に国の[[重要文化財]]に指定された。付近では、後世に[[下野国分寺跡|下野国分寺]]が隣接して営まれている。 == 埋葬施設 == 埋葬施設としては[[凝灰岩]]製切石による[[横穴式石室]]が構築されており、前方部前面において南方向に開口する。現在までに損壊を受けているが、推定復原される石室の規模は次の通り。 * 石室全長：4.2メートル - 墓道を含めると約9メートル。 * 玄室：長さ3.0メートル、幅2.0メートル、高さ1.9メートル * 羨道：長さ0.6メートル == 文化財 == === 重要文化財（国指定） === * 栃木県甲塚古墳出土品（考古資料） - 明細は以下。下野市立しもつけ風土記の丘資料館保管。2017年（平成29年）9月15日指定平成29年9月15日文部科学省告示第117号。[http://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/2017031002.html 国宝・重要文化財の指定について]（文化庁）。{{国指定文化財等データベース|201|00011756|栃木県甲塚古墳出土品}}。 ** 機織形埴輪 2点 ** 人物埴輪 17点 ** 馬形埴輪 4点 ** 須恵器 58点 ** 土師器 16点 ** （附指定）埴輪残欠 4点 ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 機織形埴輪.JPG|機織形埴輪 ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 人物埴輪1 (女性).JPG|人物埴輪1（女性） ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 人物埴輪2 (女性).JPG|人物埴輪2（女性） ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 人物埴輪15 (男性).JPG|人物埴輪15（男性） ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 人物埴輪 (盾持人).JPG|人物埴輪（盾持人） ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 馬形埴輪1.JPG|馬形埴輪1 ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 馬形埴輪3.JPG|馬形埴輪3 ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 土器群.JPG|土器群 == 関連施設 == * しもつけ風土記の丘資料館（下野市国分寺） - 甲塚古墳出土品等を保管・展示。 == 脚注 == {{脚注ヘルプ}} {{reflist}} == 参考文献 == {{small|（記事執筆に使用した文献）}} * 史跡説明板（下野市教育委員会設置） * {{Wikicite|reference={{PDFlink|[http://www.city.shimotsuke.lg.jp/manage/contents/upload/5821824673c0f.pdf 甲塚古墳出土埴輪]}}（下野市ホームページ）|ref={{Harvid|甲塚古墳出土埴輪（下野市）}}}} * {{Wikicite|reference={{PDFlink|[http://www.city.shimotsuke.lg.jp/manage/contents/upload/5821824666a85.pdf 甲塚古墳出土機織形埴輪]}}（下野市ホームページ）|ref={{Harvid|甲塚古墳出土機織形埴輪（下野市）}}}} == 関連文献 == {{small|（記事執筆に使用していない関連文献）}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2005|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 栃木県国分寺町 平成16年度規模確認調査|publisher=栃木県国分寺町教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=とちぎ未来づくり財団埋蔵文化財センター|author=|year=2012|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 重要遺跡範囲確認調査（栃木県埋蔵文化財調査報告 第343集）|publisher=栃木県教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2014|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 下野国分寺跡史跡整備関連発掘調査報告書（下野市埋蔵文化財調査報告 第11集）|publisher=下野市教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} == 関連項目 == * [[下野国分寺跡]] == 外部リンク == * {{国指定文化財等データベース|201|00011756|栃木県甲塚古墳出土品}} * [http://www.shimotsuke-bunkazai.com/culturalassets.php?id=45 甲塚古墳]、[http://www.shimotsuke-bunkazai.com/culturalassets.php?id=61 甲塚古墳出土遺物] - 分布図}} | scalemark = 60 | mark-coord1= {{Coord|36|22|20.39|N|139|48|21.31|E}} | label1=摩利支天塚 | label-pos1=right | label-color1=black | mark1=前方後円墳-南西.png | mark-size1=30 | mark-coord2= {{Coord|36|22|30.88|N|139|48|25.67|E}} | label2=琵琶塚 | label-pos2=right | label-color2=black | mark2=前方後円墳-南西.png | mark-size2=30 | mark-coord3= {{Coord|36|24|15.15|N|139|48|41.13|E}} | label3=吾妻 | label-pos3=right | label-color3=black | mark3=前方後円墳-南南東.png | mark-size3=30 | mark-coord4= {{Coord|36|23|1.80|N|139|48|18.15|E}} | label4=甲塚 | label-pos4=left | label-color4=black | mark4=帆立貝形古墳-南.png | mark-size4=25 | mark-coord5= {{Coord|36|23|33.06|N|139|48|23.26|E}} | label5=愛宕塚 | label-pos5=left | label-color5=black | mark5=前方後円墳-西南西.png | mark-size5=25 | mark-coord6= {{Coord|36|23|38.85|N|139|48|34.73|E}} | label6=山王塚 | label-pos6=left | label-color6=black | mark6=前方後円墳-西.png | mark-size6=25 | mark-coord7= {{Coord|36|23|41.67|N|139|48|39.60|E}} | label7=丸塚 | label-pos7=right | label-color7=black | mark7=円墳.png | mark-size7=25 | mark-coord8= {{Coord|36|23|6.21|N|139|48|21.95|E}} | label8=下野国分寺跡 | label-pos8=top | label-color8=black | mark8=Red pog.svg | mark-size8=10 | mark-coord9= {{Coord|36|23|6.98|N|139|48|44.73|E}} | label9=下野国分尼寺跡 | label-pos9=right | label-color9=black | mark9=Red pog.svg | mark-size9=10 | mark-coord10= {{Coord|36|22|47.5|N|139|47|6.3|E}} | label10=下野国庁跡 | label-pos10=right | label-color10=black | mark10=Red pog.svg | mark-size10=10 }} '''甲塚古墳'''（かぶとづかこふん）は、[[栃木県]][[下野市]]国分寺にある[[古墳]]。形状は[[帆立貝形古墳]]。しもつけ古墳群（うち飯塚・国分寺地域）を構成する古墳の1つ。史跡指定はされていない[http://www.shimotsuke-bunkazai.com/culturalassets.php?id=45 甲塚古墳]（下野市文化財バーチャルミュージアム）。。出土品は国の[[重要文化財]]に指定されている。 == 概要 ==
{| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff;text-align:center;font-size:85%;" |+しもつけ古墳群（飯塚・国分寺地域）一覧 !古墳名!!形状!!規模!!築造時期!!史跡指定 |- |[[摩利支天塚古墳]]||[[前方後円墳]]||墳丘長120m||5c末||国史跡 |- |[[琵琶塚古墳]]||前方後円墳||墳丘長123m||6c初頭||国史跡 |- |[[吾妻古墳]]||前方後円墳||墳丘長128m||6c後半||国史跡 |- |'''甲塚古墳'''||[[帆立貝形古墳]]||墳丘長80m||6c後半||なし |- |[[愛宕塚古墳 (下野市)|愛宕塚古墳]]||前方後円墳||墳丘長78.5m||6c末||県史跡 |- |[[山王塚古墳 (下野市)|山王塚古墳]]||前方後円墳||墳丘長89m||6c末-7c初頭||なし |- |[[丸塚古墳 (下野市)|丸塚古墳]]||[[円墳]]||直径65m||7c前半||県史跡 |}
[[ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 埴輪群.JPG|thumb|250px|right|{{center|埴輪群（国の[[重要文化財]]）}}{{small|しもつけ風土記の丘資料館展示（他画像も同様）。}}]] 栃木県南部、[[下野市]]西部の[[姿川]]と[[思川 (栃木県)|思川]]に挟まれた台地上に築造された古墳である。台地上では、本古墳のほかにも[[摩利支天塚古墳]]・[[琵琶塚古墳]]・[[吾妻古墳]]を始めとする大型古墳の分布が知られる。本古墳では[[1883年|1883]]・[[1893年]]（[[明治]]16・26年）に発掘がなされ旧状が損なわれているほか、考古学的にはこれまでに数次の発掘調査が実施されている。 墳丘は前方部が短小な帆立貝形の前方後円形で、前方部を南方向に向ける史跡説明板。。墳丘は2段築成で、特に1段目は平坦な基壇状を呈し、下野地域特有の「下野型古墳」の特徴を示す。墳丘長は推定約80メートル、主丘（ほぼ完全な円形）は直径61メートルを測る。墳丘第1段の平坦面中央部には[[円筒埴輪]]列が巡らされる。また第2段のくびれ部付近において[[形象埴輪]]（人物形・馬形埴輪など）が検出されており、特に埴輪群は当初の位置・向きまで良好に遺存する点、全国初の機織形埴輪の出土の点、一部の埴輪に彩色の残る点で注目される{{Sfn|甲塚古墳出土埴輪（下野市）}}読売新聞栃木版 2017年8月14日 20面。。埋葬施設は[[凝灰岩]]製の[[横穴式石室]]で、前方部前面において南方向に開口する。築造時期は[[古墳時代]]後期の[[6世紀]]後半頃と推定される。 出土品は[[2017年]]（[[平成]]29年）に国の[[重要文化財]]に指定された。付近では、後世に[[下野国分寺跡|下野国分寺]]が隣接して営まれている。 == 埋葬施設 == 埋葬施設としては[[凝灰岩]]製切石による[[横穴式石室]]が構築されており、前方部前面において南方向に開口する。現在までに損壊を受けているが、推定復原される石室の規模は次の通り。 * 石室全長：4.2メートル - 墓道を含めると約9メートル。 * 玄室：長さ3.0メートル、幅2.0メートル、高さ1.9メートル * 羨道：長さ0.6メートル == 文化財 == === 重要文化財（国指定） === * 栃木県甲塚古墳出土品（考古資料） - 明細は以下。下野市立しもつけ風土記の丘資料館保管。2017年（平成29年）9月15日指定平成29年9月15日文部科学省告示第117号。[http://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/2017031002.html 国宝・重要文化財の指定について]（文化庁）。{{国指定文化財等データベース|201|00011756|栃木県甲塚古墳出土品}}。 ** 機織形埴輪 2点 ** 人物埴輪 17点 ** 馬形埴輪 4点 ** 須恵器 58点 ** 土師器 16点 ** （附指定）埴輪残欠 4点 ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 機織形埴輪.JPG|機織形埴輪 ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 人物埴輪1 (女性).JPG|人物埴輪1（女性） ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 人物埴輪2 (女性).JPG|人物埴輪2（女性） ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 人物埴輪15 (男性).JPG|人物埴輪15（男性） ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 人物埴輪 (盾持人).JPG|人物埴輪（盾持人） ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 馬形埴輪1.JPG|馬形埴輪1 ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 馬形埴輪3.JPG|馬形埴輪3 ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 土器群.JPG|土器群 == 関連施設 == * しもつけ風土記の丘資料館（下野市国分寺） - 甲塚古墳出土品等を保管・展示。 == 脚注 == {{脚注ヘルプ}} {{reflist}} == 参考文献 == {{small|（記事執筆に使用した文献）}} * 史跡説明板（下野市教育委員会設置） * {{Wikicite|reference={{PDFlink|[http://www.city.shimotsuke.lg.jp/manage/contents/upload/5821824673c0f.pdf 甲塚古墳出土埴輪]}}（下野市ホームページ）|ref={{Harvid|甲塚古墳出土埴輪（下野市）}}}} * {{Wikicite|reference={{PDFlink|[http://www.city.shimotsuke.lg.jp/manage/contents/upload/5821824666a85.pdf 甲塚古墳出土機織形埴輪]}}（下野市ホームページ）|ref={{Harvid|甲塚古墳出土機織形埴輪（下野市）}}}} == 関連文献 == {{small|（記事執筆に使用していない関連文献）}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2005|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 栃木県国分寺町 平成16年度規模確認調査|publisher=栃木県国分寺町教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=とちぎ未来づくり財団埋蔵文化財センター|author=|year=2012|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 重要遺跡範囲確認調査（栃木県埋蔵文化財調査報告 第343集）|publisher=栃木県教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2014|chapter=|title=甲塚古墳 下野国分寺跡史跡整備関連発掘調査報告書（下野市埋蔵文化財調査報告 第11集）|publisher=下野市教育委員会|isbn=|page=|ref=}} == 関連項目 == * [[下野国分寺跡]] == 外部リンク == * {{国指定文化財等データベース|201|00011756|栃木県甲塚古墳出土品}} * [http://www.shimotsuke-bunkazai.com/culturalassets.php?id=45 甲塚古墳]、[http://www.shimotsuke-bunkazai.com/culturalassets.php?id=61 甲塚古墳出土遺物] - {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff;text-align:center;font-size:85%;" |+しもつけ古墳群（飯塚・国分寺地域）一覧 !古墳名!!形状!!規模!!築造時期!!史跡指定 |- |[[摩利支天塚古墳]]||[[前方後円墳]]||墳丘長120m||5c末||国史跡 |- |[[琵琶塚古墳]]||前方後円墳||墳丘長123m||6c初頭||国史跡 |- |[[吾妻古墳]]||前方後円墳||墳丘長128m||6c後半||国史跡 |- |'''甲塚古墳'''||[[帆立貝形古墳]]||墳丘長80m||6c後半||なし |- |[[愛宕塚古墳 (下野市)|愛宕塚古墳]]||前方後円墳||墳丘長78.5m||6c末||県史跡 |- |[[山王塚古墳 (下野市)|山王塚古墳]]||前方後円墳||墳丘長89m||6c末-7c初頭||なし |- |[[丸塚古墳 (下野市)|丸塚古墳]]||[[円墳]]||直径65m||7c前半||県史跡 |}
[[ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 埴輪群.JPG|thumb|250px|right|{{center|埴輪群（国の[[重要文化財]]）}}{{small|しもつけ風土記の丘資料館展示（他画像も同様）。}}]] 栃木県南部、[[下野市]]西部の[[姿川]]と[[思川 (栃木県)|思川]]に挟まれた台地上に築造された古墳である。台地上では、本古墳のほかにも[[摩利支天塚古墳]]・[[琵琶塚古墳]]・[[吾妻古墳]]を始めとする大型古墳の分布が知られる。本古墳では[[1883年|1883]]・[[1893年]]（[[明治]]16・26年）に発掘がなされ旧状が損なわれているほか、考古学的にはこれまでに数次の発掘調査が実施されている。 墳丘は前方部が短小な帆立貝形の前方後円形で、前方部を南方向に向ける史跡説明板。。墳丘は2段築成で、特に1段目は平坦な基壇状を呈し、下野地域特有の「下野型古墳」の特徴を示す。墳丘長は推定約80メートル、主丘（ほぼ完全な円形）は直径61メートルを測る。墳丘第1段の平坦面中央部には[[円筒埴輪]]列が巡らされる。また第2段のくびれ部付近において[[形象埴輪]]（人物形・馬形埴輪など）が検出されており、特に埴輪群は当初の位置・向きまで良好に遺存する点、全国初の機織形埴輪の出土の点、一部の埴輪に彩色の残る点で注目される{{Sfn|甲塚古墳出土埴輪（下野市）}}読売新聞栃木版 2017年8月14日 20面。。埋葬施設は[[凝灰岩]]製の[[横穴式石室]]で、前方部前面において南方向に開口する。築造時期は[[古墳時代]]後期の[[6世紀]]後半頃と推定される。 出土品は[[2017年]]（[[平成]]29年）に国の[[重要文化財]]に指定された。付近では、後世に[[下野国分寺跡|下野国分寺]]が隣接して営まれている。 == 埋葬施設 == 埋葬施設としては[[凝灰岩]]製切石による[[横穴式石室]]が構築されており、前方部前面において南方向に開口する。現在までに損壊を受けているが、推定復原される石室の規模は次の通り。 * 石室全長：4.2メートル - 墓道を含めると約9メートル。 * 玄室：長さ3.0メートル、幅2.0メートル、高さ1.9メートル * 羨道：長さ0.6メートル == 文化財 == === 重要文化財（国指定） === * 栃木県甲塚古墳出土品（考古資料） - 明細は以下。下野市立しもつけ風土記の丘資料館保管。2017年（平成29年）9月15日指定平成29年9月15日文部科学省告示第117号。[http://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/2017031002.html 国宝・重要文化財の指定について]（文化庁）。{{国指定文化財等データベース|201|00011756|栃木県甲塚古墳出土品}}。 ** 機織形埴輪 2点 ** 人物埴輪 17点 ** 馬形埴輪 4点 ** 須恵器 58点 ** 土師器 16点 ** （附指定）埴輪残欠 4点 ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 機織形埴輪.JPG|機織形埴輪 ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 人物埴輪1 (女性).JPG|人物埴輪1（女性） ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 人物埴輪2 (女性).JPG|人物埴輪2（女性） ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 人物埴輪15 (男性).JPG|人物埴輪15（男性） ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 人物埴輪 (盾持人).JPG|人物埴輪（盾持人） ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 馬形埴輪1.JPG|馬形埴輪1 ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 馬形埴輪3.JPG|馬形埴輪3 ファイル:甲塚古墳 (下野市) 出土 土器群.JPG|土器群 == 関連施設 == * しもつけ風土記の丘資料館（下野市国分寺） - Historic Site Status |- | {{ill|Marishitenzuka Kofun|ja|摩利支天塚古墳}} || {{ill|Keyhole-shaped burial mound|ja|前方後円墳}} || Mound length: 120m || Late 5th century || National Historic Site |- | {{ill|Biwa-no-tsuka Kofun|ja|琵琶塚古墳}} || Keyhole-shaped burial mound || Mound length: 123m || Early 6th century || National Historic Site |- | {{ill|Azuma Kofun|ja|吾妻古墳}} || Keyhole-shaped burial mound || Mound length: 128m || Late 6th century || National Historic Site |- | '''Kabutozuka Kofun''' || Scallop-shaped burial mound || Mound length: 80m || Late 6th century || None |- | {{ill|Atagozuka Kofun (Shimotsuke)|ja|愛宕塚古墳 (下野市)}} || Keyhole-shaped burial mound || Mound length: 78.5m || Late 6th century || Prefectural Historic Site |- | {{ill|Sannozuka Kofun (Shimotsuke)|ja|山王塚古墳 (下野市)}} || Keyhole-shaped burial mound || Mound length: 89m || Late 6th–Early 7th century || None |- | {{ill|Marutsuka Kofun (Shimotsuke)|ja|丸塚古墳 (下野市)}} || {{ill|Round burial mound|ja|円墳}} || Diameter: 65m || Early 7th century || Prefectural Historic Site |}
Kabutozuka Kofun is located on a plateau in western {{ill|Shimotsuke City|ja|下野市}}, nestled between the {{ill|Sugata River|ja|姿川}} and {{ill|Omoi River (Tochigi)|ja|思川}}. The area features a cluster of burial mounds, including notable large-scale tumuli such as {{ill|Marishitenzuka Kofun|ja|摩利支天塚古墳}}, {{ill|Biwa-no-tsuka Kofun|ja|琵琶塚古墳}}, and {{ill|Azuma Kofun|ja|吾妻古墳}}. This mound underwent archaeological investigations during 1883 and 1893 (Meiji 16 and 26), which resulted in significant changes to its original condition. The tumulus is characterized as a scallop-shaped keyhole mound with a short anterior mound facing south. It features a two-tiered mound structure, with the first tier having a flat base characteristic of the unique "Shimotsuke-style mounds" of the region. The mound measures approximately 80 meters in length, with the main circular mound measuring 61 meters in diameter. Distinctive finds include rows of cylindrical {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪}} and decorative Haniwa figures, such as weavers, humans, and horses, notable for their excellent preservation, original positions, and traces of paintHistoric Site Explanation Board.. The burial chamber is a tuff-stone {{ill|Yokoana stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室}}, opening southward from the anterior mound. The tumulus is dated to the late 6th century. Artifacts excavated from the mound were designated as Important Cultural Properties of Japan in 2017. The site lies adjacent to the ruins of the {{ill|Shimotsuke Kokubun-ji|ja|下野国分寺跡}} temple complex. == Burial Facility == The burial chamber is constructed from cut tuff stones and is oriented southward from the anterior mound. Although partially destroyed, the chamber's dimensions are estimated as follows: * Total length: 4.2 meters (approximately 9 meters including the burial path). * Main chamber: Length 3.0 meters, Width 2.0 meters, Height 1.9 meters. * Entry passage: Length 0.6 meters. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (Nationally Designated) === * Artifacts excavated from Kabutozuka Kofun, Tochigi Prefecture (archaeological materials). Stored and exhibited at the Shimotsuke Fudoki-no-Oka Museum. Designated on September 15, 2017Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 117, September 15, 2017.[http://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/2017031002.html Regarding National Treasures and Important Cultural Properties Designation] (Agency for Cultural Affairs).{{National Cultural Property Database|201|00011756|Kabutozuka Kofun Artifacts}}. ** Weaving Haniwa figures (2 items). ** Human-shaped Haniwa (17 items). ** Horse-shaped Haniwa (4 items). ** {{ill|Sue ware|ja|須恵器}} (58 items). ** {{ill|Haji ware|ja|土師器}} (16 items). ** (Supplementary designation): Haniwa fragments (4 items). File:Kabutozuka Kofun (Shimotsuke) weaving haniwa.JPG|Weaving Haniwa File:Kabutozuka Kofun (Shimotsuke) human haniwa1 (female).JPG|Female Haniwa 1 File:Kabutozuka Kofun (Shimotsuke) human haniwa2 (female).JPG|Female Haniwa 2 File:Kabutozuka Kofun (Shimotsuke) male haniwa15.JPG|Male Haniwa 15 File:Kabutozuka Kofun (Shimotsuke) shield haniwa.JPG|Shield-bearing Haniwa File:Kabutozuka Kofun (Shimotsuke) horse haniwa1.JPG|Horse Haniwa 1 File:Kabutozuka Kofun (Shimotsuke) horse haniwa3.JPG|Horse Haniwa 3 File:Kabutozuka Kofun (Shimotsuke) pottery set.JPG|Pottery group == Related Facilities == * Shimotsuke Fudoki-no-Oka Museum (Shimotsuke City Kokubunji) - Holds and exhibits artifacts from Kabutozuka Kofun. == References == {{Reflist}} == Related Reading == * Historic Site Explanation Board (installed by Shimotsuke City Board of Education). * {{Wikicite|reference={{PDFlink|[http://www.city.shimotsuke.lg.jp/manage/contents/upload/5821824673c0f.pdf Kabutozuka Kofun Excavation Report]}} (Shimotsuke City Official Website)|ref={{Harvid|Kabutozuka Kofun Excavation Report (Shimotsuke)}}}}. * {{Wikicite|reference={{PDFlink|[http://www.city.shimotsuke.lg.jp/manage/contents/upload/5821824666a85.pdf Weaving Haniwa from Kabutozuka Kofun]}} (Shimotsuke City Official Website)|ref={{Harvid|Weaving Haniwa (Shimotsuke)}}}}. == External Links == * {{National Cultural Property Database|201|00011756|Kabutozuka Kofun Artifacts}} * [http://www.shimotsuke-bunkazai.com/culturalassets.php?id=45 Kabutozuka Kofun], [http://www.shimotsuke-bunkazai.com/culturalassets.php?id=61 Kabutozuka Kofun Artifacts] - Shimotsuke City Cultural Property Virtual Museum [[Category:Ancient Burial Mounds in Tochigi Prefecture]] [[Category:History of Shimotsuke City]] [[Category:Scallop-shaped Burial Mounds]] [[Category:Important Cultural Properties of Japan]] [[ja:甲塚古墳 (下野市)]]

Historic Site Status |- | {{ill|Marishitenzuka Kofun|ja|摩利支天塚古墳}} || {{ill|Keyhole-shaped burial mound|ja|前方後円墳}} || Mound length: 120m || Late 5th century || National Historic Site |- | {{ill|Biwa-no-tsuka Kofun|ja|琵琶塚古墳}} || Keyhole-shaped burial mound || Mound length: 123m || Early 6th century || National Historic Site |- | {{ill|Azuma Kofun|ja|吾妻古墳}} || Keyhole-shaped burial mound || Mound length: 128m || Late 6th century || National Historic Site |- | '''Kabutozuka Kofun''' || Scallop-shaped burial mound || Mound length: 80m || Late 6th century || None |- | {{ill|Atagozuka Kofun (Shimotsuke)|ja|愛宕塚古墳 (下野市)}} || Keyhole-shaped burial mound || Mound length: 78.5m || Late 6th century || Prefectural Historic Site |- | {{ill|Sannozuka Kofun (Shimotsuke)|ja|山王塚古墳 (下野市)}} || Keyhole-shaped burial mound || Mound length: 89m || Late 6th–Early 7th century || None |- | {{ill|Marutsuka Kofun (Shimotsuke)|ja|丸塚古墳 (下野市)}} || {{ill|Round burial mound|ja|円墳}} || Diameter: 65m || Early 7th century || Prefectural Historic Site |}
Kabutozuka Kofun is located on a plateau in western {{ill|Shimotsuke City|ja|下野市}}, nestled between the {{ill|Sugata River|ja|姿川}} and {{ill|Omoi River (Tochigi)|ja|思川}}. The area features a cluster of burial mounds, including notable large-scale tumuli such as {{ill|Marishitenzuka Kofun|ja|摩利支天塚古墳}}, {{ill|Biwa-no-tsuka Kofun|ja|琵琶塚古墳}}, and {{ill|Azuma Kofun|ja|吾妻古墳}}. This mound underwent archaeological investigations during 1883 and 1893 (Meiji 16 and 26), which resulted in significant changes to its original condition. The tumulus is characterized as a scallop-shaped keyhole mound with a short anterior mound facing south. It features a two-tiered mound structure, with the first tier having a flat base characteristic of the unique "Shimotsuke-style mounds" of the region. The mound measures approximately 80 meters in length, with the main circular mound measuring 61 meters in diameter. Distinctive finds include rows of cylindrical {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪}} and decorative Haniwa figures, such as weavers, humans, and horses, notable for their excellent preservation, original positions, and traces of paintHistoric Site Explanation Board.. The burial chamber is a tuff-stone {{ill|Yokoana stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室}}, opening southward from the anterior mound. The tumulus is dated to the late 6th century. Artifacts excavated from the mound were designated as Important Cultural Properties of Japan in 2017. The site lies adjacent to the ruins of the {{ill|Shimotsuke Kokubun-ji|ja|下野国分寺跡}} temple complex. == Burial Facility == The burial chamber is constructed from cut tuff stones and is oriented southward from the anterior mound. Although partially destroyed, the chamber's dimensions are estimated as follows: * Total length: 4.2 meters (approximately 9 meters including the burial path). * Main chamber: Length 3.0 meters, Width 2.0 meters, Height 1.9 meters. * Entry passage: Length 0.6 meters. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (Nationally Designated) === * Artifacts excavated from Kabutozuka Kofun, Tochigi Prefecture (archaeological materials). Stored and exhibited at the Shimotsuke Fudoki-no-Oka Museum. Designated on September 15, 2017Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 117, September 15, 2017.[http://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/2017031002.html Regarding National Treasures and Important Cultural Properties Designation] (Agency for Cultural Affairs).{{National Cultural Property Database|201|00011756|Kabutozuka Kofun Artifacts}}. ** Weaving Haniwa figures (2 items). ** Human-shaped Haniwa (17 items). ** Horse-shaped Haniwa (4 items). ** {{ill|Sue ware|ja|須恵器}} (58 items). ** {{ill|Haji ware|ja|土師器}} (16 items). ** (Supplementary designation): Haniwa fragments (4 items). Kabutozuka Kofun is located on a plateau in western {{ill|Shimotsuke City|ja|下野市}}, nestled between the {{ill|Sugata River|ja|姿川}} and {{ill|Omoi River (Tochigi)|ja|思川}}. The area features a cluster of burial mounds, including notable large-scale tumuli such as {{ill|Marishitenzuka Kofun|ja|摩利支天塚古墳}}, {{ill|Biwa-no-tsuka Kofun|ja|琵琶塚古墳}}, and {{ill|Azuma Kofun|ja|吾妻古墳}}. This mound underwent archaeological investigations during 1883 and 1893 (Meiji 16 and 26), which resulted in significant changes to its original condition. The tumulus is characterized as a scallop-shaped keyhole mound with a short anterior mound facing south. It features a two-tiered mound structure, with the first tier having a flat base characteristic of the unique "Shimotsuke-style mounds" of the region. The mound measures approximately 80 meters in length, with the main circular mound measuring 61 meters in diameter. Distinctive finds include rows of cylindrical {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪}} and decorative Haniwa figures, such as weavers, humans, and horses, notable for their excellent preservation, original positions, and traces of paintHistoric Site Explanation Board.. The burial chamber is a tuff-stone {{ill|Yokoana stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室}}, opening southward from the anterior mound. The tumulus is dated to the late 6th century. Artifacts excavated from the mound were designated as Important Cultural Properties of Japan in 2017. The site lies adjacent to the ruins of the {{ill|Shimotsuke Kokubun-ji|ja|下野国分寺跡}} temple complex. == Burial Facility == The burial chamber is constructed from cut tuff stones and is oriented southward from the anterior mound. Although partially destroyed, the chamber's dimensions are estimated as follows: * Total length: 4.2 meters (approximately 9 meters including the burial path). * Main chamber: Length 3.0 meters, Width 2.0 meters, Height 1.9 meters. * Entry passage: Length 0.6 meters. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (Nationally Designated) === * Artifacts excavated from Kabutozuka Kofun, Tochigi Prefecture (archaeological materials). Stored and exhibited at the Shimotsuke Fudoki-no-Oka Museum. Designated on September 15, 2017Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 117, September 15, 2017.[http://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/2017031002.html Regarding National Treasures and Important Cultural Properties Designation] (Agency for Cultural Affairs).{{National Cultural Property Database|201|00011756|Kabutozuka Kofun Artifacts}}. ** Weaving Haniwa figures (2 items). ** Human-shaped Haniwa (17 items). ** Horse-shaped Haniwa (4 items). ** {{ill|Sue ware|ja|須恵器}} (58 items). ** {{ill|Haji ware|ja|土師器}} (16 items). ** (Supplementary designation): Haniwa fragments (4 items). Holds and exhibits artifacts from Kabutozuka Kofun. == References == {{Reflist}} == Related Reading == * Historic Site Explanation Board (installed by Shimotsuke City Board of Education). * {{Wikicite|reference={{PDFlink|[http://www.city.shimotsuke.lg.jp/manage/contents/upload/5821824673c0f.pdf Kabutozuka Kofun Excavation Report]}} (Shimotsuke City Official Website)|ref={{Harvid|Kabutozuka Kofun Excavation Report (Shimotsuke)}}}}. * {{Wikicite|reference={{PDFlink|[http://www.city.shimotsuke.lg.jp/manage/contents/upload/5821824666a85.pdf Weaving Haniwa from Kabutozuka Kofun]}} (Shimotsuke City Official Website)|ref={{Harvid|Weaving Haniwa (Shimotsuke)}}}}. == External Links == * {{National Cultural Property Database|201|00011756|Kabutozuka Kofun Artifacts}} * [http://www.shimotsuke-bunkazai.com/culturalassets.php?id=45 Kabutozuka Kofun], [http://www.shimotsuke-bunkazai.com/culturalassets.php?id=61 Kabutozuka Kofun Artifacts] - Kabutozuka Kofun is located on a plateau in western {{ill|Shimotsuke City|ja|下野市}}, nestled between the {{ill|Sugata River|ja|姿川}} and {{ill|Omoi River (Tochigi)|ja|思川}}. The area features a cluster of burial mounds, including notable large-scale tumuli such as {{ill|Marishitenzuka Kofun|ja|摩利支天塚古墳}}, {{ill|Biwazuka Kofun|ja|琵琶塚古墳}}, and {{ill|Azuma Kofun|ja|吾妻古墳}}. This mound underwent archaeological investigations during 1883 and 1893 (Meiji 16 and 26), which resulted in significant changes to its original condition. The tumulus is characterized as a scallop-shaped keyhole mound with a short anterior mound facing south. It features a two-tiered mound structure, with the first tier having a flat base characteristic of the unique "Shimotsuke-style mounds" of the region. The mound measures approximately 80 meters in length, with the main circular mound measuring 61 meters in diameter. Distinctive finds include rows of cylindrical {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪}} and decorative Haniwa figures, such as weavers, humans, and horses, notable for their excellent preservation, original positions, and traces of paintHistoric Site Explanation Board.. The burial chamber is a tuff-stone {{ill|Yokoana stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室}}, opening southward from the anterior mound. The tumulus is dated to the late 6th century. Artifacts excavated from the mound were designated as Important Cultural Properties of Japan in 2017. The site lies adjacent to the ruins of the {{ill|Shimotsuke Kokubun-ji|ja|下野国分寺跡}} temple complex. == Burial Facility == The burial chamber is constructed from cut tuff stones and is oriented southward from the anterior mound. Although partially destroyed, the chamber's dimensions are estimated as follows: * Total length: 4.2 meters (approximately 9 meters including the burial path). * Main chamber: Length 3.0 meters, Width 2.0 meters, Height 1.9 meters. * Entry passage: Length 0.6 meters. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (Nationally Designated) === * Artifacts excavated from Kabutozuka Kofun, Tochigi Prefecture (archaeological materials). Stored and exhibited at the Shimotsuke Fudoki-no-Oka Museum. Designated on September 15, 2017Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 117, September 15, 2017.[http://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/2017031002.html Regarding National Treasures and Important Cultural Properties Designation] (Agency for Cultural Affairs).{{National Cultural Property Database|201|00011756|Kabutozuka Kofun Artifacts}}. ** Weaving Haniwa figures (2 items). ** Human-shaped Haniwa (17 items). ** Horse-shaped Haniwa (4 items). ** {{ill|Sue ware|ja|須恵器}} (58 items). ** {{ill|Haji ware|ja|土師器}} (16 items). ** (Supplementary designation): Haniwa fragments (4 items). Kabutozuka Kofun is located on a plateau in western {{ill|Shimotsuke City|ja|下野市}}, nestled between the {{ill|Sugata River|ja|姿川}} and {{ill|Omoi River (Tochigi)|ja|思川}}. The area features a cluster of burial mounds, including notable large-scale tumuli such as {{ill|Marishitenzuka Kofun|ja|摩利支天塚古墳}}, {{ill|Biwazuka Kofun|ja|琵琶塚古墳}}, and {{ill|Azuma Kofun|ja|吾妻古墳}}. This mound underwent archaeological investigations during 1883 and 1893 (Meiji 16 and 26), which resulted in significant changes to its original condition. The tumulus is characterized as a scallop-shaped keyhole mound with a short anterior mound facing south. It features a two-tiered mound structure, with the first tier having a flat base characteristic of the unique "Shimotsuke-style mounds" of the region. The mound measures approximately 80 meters in length, with the main circular mound measuring 61 meters in diameter. Distinctive finds include rows of cylindrical {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪}} and decorative Haniwa figures, such as weavers, humans, and horses, notable for their excellent preservation, original positions, and traces of paintHistoric Site Explanation Board.. The burial chamber is a tuff-stone {{ill|Yokoana stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室}}, opening southward from the anterior mound. The tumulus is dated to the late 6th century. Artifacts excavated from the mound were designated as Important Cultural Properties of Japan in 2017. The site lies adjacent to the ruins of the {{ill|Shimotsuke Kokubun-ji|ja|下野国分寺跡}} temple complex. == Burial Facility == The burial chamber is constructed from cut tuff stones and is oriented southward from the anterior mound. Although partially destroyed, the chamber's dimensions are estimated as follows: * Total length: 4.2 meters (approximately 9 meters including the burial path). * Main chamber: Length 3.0 meters, Width 2.0 meters, Height 1.9 meters. * Entry passage: Length 0.6 meters. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (Nationally Designated) === * Artifacts excavated from Kabutozuka Kofun, Tochigi Prefecture (archaeological materials). Stored and exhibited at the Shimotsuke Fudoki-no-Oka Museum. Designated on September 15, 2017Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 117, September 15, 2017.[http://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/2017031002.html Regarding National Treasures and Important Cultural Properties Designation] (Agency for Cultural Affairs).{{National Cultural Property Database|201|00011756|Kabutozuka Kofun Artifacts}}. ** Weaving Haniwa figures (2 items). ** Human-shaped Haniwa (17 items). ** Horse-shaped Haniwa (4 items). ** {{ill|Sue ware|ja|須恵器}} (58 items). ** {{ill|Haji ware|ja|土師器}} (16 items). ** (Supplementary designation): Haniwa fragments (4 items). Kabutozuka Kofun is located on a plateau in western {{ill|Shimotsuke City|ja|下野市}}, nestled between the {{ill|Sugata River|ja|姿川}} and {{ill|Omoi River (Tochigi)|ja|思川}}. The area features a cluster of burial mounds, including notable large-scale tumuli such as {{ill|Marishitenzuka Kofun|ja|摩利支天塚古墳}}, {{ill|Biwazuka Kofun|ja|琵琶塚古墳}}, and {{ill|Azuma Kofun|ja|吾妻古墳}}. This mound underwent archaeological investigations during 1883 and 1893 (Meiji 16 and 26), which resulted in significant changes to its original condition. The tumulus is characterized as a scallop-shaped keyhole mound with a short anterior mound facing south. It features a two-tiered mound structure, with the first tier having a flat base characteristic of the unique "Shimotsuke-style mounds" of the region. The mound measures approximately 80 meters in length, with the main circular mound measuring 61 meters in diameter. Distinctive finds include rows of cylindrical {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪}} and decorative Haniwa figures, such as weavers, humans, and horses, notable for their excellent preservation, original positions, and traces of paintHistoric Site Explanation Board.. The burial chamber is a tuff-stone {{ill|Yokoana stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室}}, opening southward from the anterior mound. The tumulus is dated to the late 6th century. Artifacts excavated from the mound were designated as Important Cultural Properties of Japan in 2017. The site lies adjacent to the ruins of the {{ill|Shimotsuke Kokubun-ji|ja|下野国分寺跡}} temple complex. == Burial Facility == The burial chamber is constructed from cut tuff stones and is oriented southward from the anterior mound. Although partially destroyed, the chamber's dimensions are estimated as follows: * Total length: 4.2 meters (approximately 9 meters including the burial path). * Main chamber: Length 3.0 meters, Width 2.0 meters, Height 1.9 meters. * Entry passage: Length 0.6 meters. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (Nationally Designated) === * Artifacts excavated from Kabutozuka Kofun, Tochigi Prefecture (archaeological materials). Stored and exhibited at the Shimotsuke Fudoki-no-Oka Museum. Designated on September 15, 2017Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 117, September 15, 2017.[http://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/2017031002.html Regarding National Treasures and Important Cultural Properties Designation] (Agency for Cultural Affairs).{{National Cultural Property Database|201|00011756|Kabutozuka Kofun Artifacts}}. ** Weaving Haniwa figures (2 items). ** Human-shaped Haniwa (17 items). ** Horse-shaped Haniwa (4 items). ** {{ill|Sue ware|ja|須恵器}} (58 items). ** {{ill|Haji ware|ja|土師器}} (16 items). ** (Supplementary designation): Haniwa fragments (4 items). Kabutozuka Kofun is located on a plateau in western {{ill|Shimotsuke City|ja|下野市}}, nestled between the {{ill|Sugata River|ja|姿川}} and {{ill|Omoi River (Tochigi)|ja|思川}}. The area features a cluster of burial mounds, including notable large-scale tumuli such as {{ill|Marishitenzuka Kofun|ja|摩利支天塚古墳}}, {{ill|Biwazuka Kofun|ja|琵琶塚古墳}}, and {{ill|Azuma Kofun|ja|吾妻古墳}}. This mound underwent archaeological investigations during 1883 and 1893 (Meiji 16 and 26), which resulted in significant changes to its original condition. The tumulus is characterized as a scallop-shaped keyhole mound with a short anterior mound facing south. It features a two-tiered mound structure, with the first tier having a flat base characteristic of the unique "Shimotsuke-style mounds" of the region. The mound measures approximately 80 meters in length, with the main circular mound measuring 61 meters in diameter. Distinctive finds include rows of cylindrical {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪}} and decorative Haniwa figures, such as weavers, humans, and horses, notable for their excellent preservation, original positions, and traces of paintHistoric Site Explanation Board.. The burial chamber is a tuff-stone {{ill|Yokoana stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室}}, opening southward from the anterior mound. The tumulus is dated to the late 6th century. Artifacts excavated from the mound were designated as Important Cultural Properties of Japan in 2017. The site lies adjacent to the ruins of the {{ill|Shimotsuke Kokubun-ji|ja|下野国分寺跡}} temple complex. == Burial Facility == The burial chamber is constructed from cut tuff stones and is oriented southward from the anterior mound. Although partially destroyed, the chamber's dimensions are estimated as follows: * Total length: 4.2 meters (approximately 9 meters including the burial path). * Main chamber: Length 3.0 meters, Width 2.0 meters, Height 1.9 meters. * Entry passage: Length 0.6 meters. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (Nationally Designated) === * Artifacts excavated from Kabutozuka Kofun, Tochigi Prefecture (archaeological materials). The mound measures approximately 80 meters in length, with the main circular mound measuring 61 meters in diameter. Kabutozuka Kofun is located on a plateau in western {{ill|Shimotsuke City|ja|下野市}}, nestled between the {{ill|Sugata River|ja|姿川}} and {{ill|Omoi River (Tochigi)|ja|思川}}. The area features a cluster of burial mounds, including notable large-scale tumuli such as {{ill|Marishitenzuka Kofun|ja|摩利支天塚古墳}}, {{ill|Biwazuka Kofun|ja|琵琶塚古墳}}, and {{ill|Azuma Kofun|ja|吾妻古墳}}. This mound underwent archaeological investigations during 1883 and 1893 (Meiji 16 and 26), which resulted in significant changes to its original condition. The tumulus is characterized as a scallop-shaped keyhole mound with a short anterior mound facing south. It features a two-tiered mound structure, with the first tier having a flat base characteristic of the unique "Shimotsuke-style mounds" of the region. The mound measures approximately 80 meters in length, with the main circular mound measuring 61 meters in diameter. Distinctive finds include rows of cylindrical {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪}} and decorative Haniwa figures, such as weavers, humans, and horses, notable for their excellent preservation, original positions, and traces of paintHistoric Site Explanation Board.. The burial chamber is a tuff-stone {{ill|Yokoana stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室}}, opening southward from the anterior mound. The tumulus is dated to the late 6th century. Artifacts excavated from the mound were designated as Important Cultural Properties of Japan in 2017. The site lies adjacent to the ruins of the {{ill|Shimotsuke Kokubun-ji|ja|下野国分寺跡}} temple complex. == Burial Facility == The burial chamber is constructed from cut tuff stones and is oriented southward from the anterior mound. Although partially destroyed, the chamber's dimensions are estimated as follows: * Total length: 4.2 meters (approximately 9 meters including the burial path). * Main chamber: Length 3.0 meters, Width 2.0 meters, Height 1.9 meters. * Entry passage: Length 0.6 meters. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (Nationally Designated) === * Artifacts excavated from Kabutozuka Kofun, Tochigi Prefecture (archaeological materials). Stored and exhibited at the Shimotsuke Fudoki-no-Oka Museum. Designated on September 15, 2017Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 117, September 15, 2017.[http://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/2017031002.html Regarding National Treasures and Important Cultural Properties Designation] (Agency for Cultural Affairs).{{National Cultural Property Database|201|00011756|Kabutozuka Kofun Artifacts}}. ** Weaving Haniwa figures (2 items). ** Human-shaped Haniwa (17 items). ** Horse-shaped Haniwa (4 items). ** {{ill|Sue ware|ja|須恵器}} (58 items). ** {{ill|Haji ware|ja|土師器}} (16 items). ** (Supplementary designation): Haniwa fragments (4 items). Kabutozuka Kofun is located on a plateau in western {{ill|Shimotsuke City|ja|下野市}}, nestled between the {{ill|Sugata River|ja|姿川}} and {{ill|Omoi River (Tochigi)|ja|思川}}. The area features a cluster of burial mounds, including notable large-scale tumuli such as {{ill|Marishitenzuka Kofun|ja|摩利支天塚古墳}}, {{ill|Biwazuka Kofun|ja|琵琶塚古墳}}, and {{ill|Azuma Kofun|ja|吾妻古墳}}. This mound underwent archaeological investigations during 1883 and 1893 (Meiji 16 and 26), which resulted in significant changes to its original condition. The tumulus is characterized as a scallop-shaped keyhole mound with a short anterior mound facing south. It features a two-tiered mound structure, with the first tier having a flat base characteristic of the unique "Shimotsuke-style mounds" of the region. The mound measures approximately 80 meters in length, with the main circular mound measuring 61 meters in diameter. Distinctive finds include rows of cylindrical {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪}} and decorative Haniwa figures, such as weavers, humans, and horses, notable for their excellent preservation, original positions, and traces of paintHistoric Site Explanation Board.. The burial chamber is a tuff-stone {{ill|Yokoana stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室}}, opening southward from the anterior mound. The tumulus is dated to the late 6th century. Artifacts excavated from the mound were designated as Important Cultural Properties of Japan in 2017. The site lies adjacent to the ruins of the {{ill|Shimotsuke Kokubun-ji|ja|下野国分寺跡}} temple complex. == Burial Facility == The burial chamber is constructed from cut tuff stones and is oriented southward from the anterior mound. Although partially destroyed, the chamber's dimensions are estimated as follows: * Total length: 4.2 meters (approximately 9 meters including the burial path). * Main chamber: Length 3.0 meters, Width 2.0 meters, Height 1.9 meters. * Entry passage: Length 0.6 meters. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (Nationally Designated) === * Artifacts excavated from Kabutozuka Kofun, Tochigi Prefecture (archaeological materials). Stored and exhibited at the Shimotsuke Fudoki-no-Oka Museum. Designated on September 15, 2017Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 117, September 15, 2017.[http://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/2017031002.html Regarding National Treasures and Important Cultural Properties Designation] (Agency for Cultural Affairs).{{National Cultural Property Database|201|00011756|Kabutozuka Kofun Artifacts}}. ** Weaving Haniwa figures (2 items). ** Human-shaped Haniwa (17 items). ** Horse-shaped Haniwa (4 items). ** {{ill|Sue ware|ja|須恵器}} (58 items). ** {{ill|Haji ware|ja|土師器}} (16 items). ** (Supplementary designation): Haniwa fragments (4 items). Kabutozuka Kofun is located on a plateau in western {{ill|Shimotsuke City|ja|下野市}}, nestled between the {{ill|Sugata River|ja|姿川}} and {{ill|Omoi River (Tochigi)|ja|思川}}. The area features a cluster of burial mounds, including notable large-scale tumuli such as {{ill|Marishitenzuka Kofun|ja|摩利支天塚古墳}}, {{ill|Biwazuka Kofun|ja|琵琶塚古墳}}, and {{ill|Azuma Kofun|ja|吾妻古墳}}. This mound underwent archaeological investigations during 1883 and 1893 (Meiji 16 and 26), which resulted in significant changes to its original condition. The tumulus is characterized as a scallop-shaped keyhole mound with a short anterior mound facing south. It features a two-tiered mound structure, with the first tier having a flat base characteristic of the unique "Shimotsuke-style mounds" of the region. The mound measures approximately 80 meters in length, with the main circular mound measuring 61 meters in diameter. Distinctive finds include rows of cylindrical {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪}} and decorative Haniwa figures, such as weavers, humans, and horses, notable for their excellent preservation, original positions, and traces of paintHistoric Site Explanation Board.. The burial chamber is a tuff-stone {{ill|Yokoana stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室}}, opening southward from the anterior mound. The tumulus is dated to the late 6th century. Artifacts excavated from the mound were designated as Important Cultural Properties of Japan in 2017. The site lies adjacent to the ruins of the {{ill|Shimotsuke Kokubun-ji|ja|下野国分寺跡}} temple complex. == Burial Facility == The burial chamber is constructed from cut tuff stones and is oriented southward from the anterior mound. Although partially destroyed, the chamber's dimensions are estimated as follows: * Total length: 4.2 meters (approximately 9 meters including the burial path). * Main chamber: Length 3.0 meters, Width 2.0 meters, Height 1.9 meters. * Entry passage: Length 0.6 meters. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (Nationally Designated) === * Artifacts excavated from Kabutozuka Kofun, Tochigi Prefecture (archaeological materials). Kabutozuka Kofun is located on a plateau in western {{ill|Shimotsuke City|ja|下野市}}, nestled between the {{ill|Sugata River|ja|姿川}} and {{ill|Omoi River (Tochigi)|ja|思川}}. The area features a cluster of burial mounds, including notable large-scale tumuli such as {{ill|Marishitenzuka Kofun|ja|摩利支天塚古墳}}, {{ill|Biwazuka Kofun|ja|琵琶塚古墳}}, and {{ill|Azuma Kofun|ja|吾妻古墳}}. This mound underwent archaeological investigations during 1883 and 1893 (Meiji 16 and 26), which resulted in significant changes to its original condition. The tumulus is characterized as a scallop-shaped keyhole mound with a short anterior mound facing south. It features a two-tiered mound structure, with the first tier having a flat base characteristic of the unique "Shimotsuke-style mounds" of the region. The mound measures approximately 80 meters in length, with the main circular mound measuring 61 meters in diameter. Distinctive finds include rows of cylindrical {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪}} and decorative Haniwa figures, such as weavers, humans, and horses, notable for their excellent preservation, original positions, and traces of paintHistoric Site Explanation Board.. The burial chamber is a tuff-stone {{ill|Yokoana stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室}}, opening southward from the anterior mound. The tumulus is dated to the late 6th century. Artifacts excavated from the mound were designated as Important Cultural Properties of Japan in 2017. The site lies adjacent to the ruins of the {{ill|Shimotsuke Kokubun-ji|ja|下野国分寺跡}} temple complex. == Burial Facility == The burial chamber is constructed from cut tuff stones and is oriented southward from the anterior mound. Although partially destroyed, the chamber's dimensions are estimated as follows: * Total length: 4.2 meters (approximately 9 meters including the burial path). * Main chamber: Length 3.0 meters, Width 2.0 meters, Height 1.9 meters. * Entry passage: Length 0.6 meters. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (Nationally Designated) === * Artifacts excavated from Kabutozuka Kofun, Tochigi Prefecture (archaeological materials). Stored and exhibited at the Shimotsuke Fudoki-no-Oka Museum. Designated on September 15, 2017Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 117, September 15, 2017.[http://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/2017031002.html Regarding National Treasures and Important Cultural Properties Designation] (Agency for Cultural Affairs).{{National Cultural Property Database|201|00011756|Kabutozuka Kofun Artifacts}}. ** Weaving Haniwa figures (2 items). ** Human-shaped Haniwa (17 items). ** Horse-shaped Haniwa (4 items). ** {{ill|Sue ware|ja|須恵器}} (58 items). ** {{ill|Haji ware|ja|土師器}} (16 items). ** (Supplementary designation): Haniwa fragments (4 items). Tumulus (central posterior mound, left anterior mound) | group = Shimotsuke Burial Mound Cluster (Iizuka-Kokubunji Area) | location = {{ill|Shimotsuke City|ja|下野市}}, Tochigi Prefecture, Kokubunji 847 | latitude = 36|longitude = 139|latd = 36|latm = 23|lats = 1.80|longd = 139|longm = 48|longs = 18.15 | iso = JP-09 | shape = {{ill|Scallop-shaped burial mound|ja|帆立貝形古墳}} | size = Mound length: 80m | constructed = Late 6th century | burial facility = {{ill|Yokoana stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室}} | deceased = Unknown | artifacts = {{ill|Sue ware|ja|須恵器}}, {{ill|Haji ware|ja|土師器}}, {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪}} | historic site = None | cultural property = Artifacts designated as Important Cultural Property of Japan | map = Japan Tochigi | label = Kabutozuka Kofun | icon = | label_position = top }} == Overview ==

Kabutozuka Kofun is located on a plateau in western {{ill|Shimotsuke City|ja|下野市}}, nestled between the {{ill|Sugata River|ja|姿川}} and {{ill|Omoi River (Tochigi)|ja|思川}}. The area features a cluster of burial mounds, including notable large-scale tumuli such as {{ill|Marishitenzuka Kofun|ja|摩利支天塚古墳}}, {{ill|Biwazuka Kofun|ja|琵琶塚古墳}}, and {{ill|Azuma Kofun|ja|吾妻古墳}}. This mound underwent archaeological investigations during 1883 and 1893 (Meiji 16 and 26), which resulted in significant changes to its original condition. The tumulus is characterized as a scallop-shaped keyhole mound with a short anterior mound facing south. It features a two-tiered mound structure, with the first tier having a flat base characteristic of the unique "Shimotsuke-style mounds" of the region. The mound measures approximately 80 meters in length, with the main circular mound measuring 61 meters in diameter. Distinctive finds include rows of cylindrical {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪}} and decorative Haniwa figures, such as weavers, humans, and horses, notable for their excellent preservation, original positions, and traces of paintHistoric Site Explanation Board.. The burial chamber is a tuff-stone {{ill|Yokoana stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室}}, opening southward from the anterior mound. The tumulus is dated to the late 6th century. Artifacts excavated from the mound were designated as Important Cultural Properties of Japan in 2017. The site lies adjacent to the ruins of the {{ill|Shimotsuke Kokubun-ji|ja|下野国分寺跡}} temple complex. == Burial Facility == The burial chamber is constructed from cut tuff stones and is oriented southward from the anterior mound. Although partially destroyed, the chamber's dimensions are estimated as follows: * Total length: 4.2 meters (approximately 9 meters including the burial path). * Main chamber: Length 3.0 meters, Width 2.0 meters, Height 1.9 meters. * Entry passage: Length 0.6 meters. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (Nationally Designated) === * Artifacts excavated from Kabutozuka Kofun, Tochigi Prefecture (archaeological materials). Stored and exhibited at the Shimotsuke Fudoki-no-Oka Museum. Designated on September 15, 2017Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 117, September 15, 2017.[http://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/2017031002.html Regarding National Treasures and Important Cultural Properties Designation] (Agency for Cultural Affairs).{{National Cultural Property Database|201|00011756|Kabutozuka Kofun Artifacts}}. ** Weaving Haniwa figures (2 items). ** Human-shaped Haniwa (17 items). ** Horse-shaped Haniwa (4 items). ** {{ill|Sue ware|ja|須恵器}} (58 items). ** {{ill|Haji ware|ja|土師器}} (16 items). ** (Supplementary designation): Haniwa fragments (4 items). Kabutozuka Kofun is located on a plateau in western {{ill|Shimotsuke City|ja|下野市}}, nestled between the {{ill|Sugata River|ja|姿川}} and {{ill|Omoi River (Tochigi)|ja|思川}}. The area features a cluster of burial mounds, including notable large-scale tumuli such as {{ill|Marishitenzuka Kofun|ja|摩利支天塚古墳}}, {{ill|Biwazuka Kofun|ja|琵琶塚古墳}}, and {{ill|Azuma Kofun|ja|吾妻古墳}}. This mound underwent archaeological investigations during 1883 and 1893 (Meiji 16 and 26), which resulted in significant changes to its original condition. The tumulus is characterized as a scallop-shaped keyhole mound with a short anterior mound facing south. It features a two-tiered mound structure, with the first tier having a flat base characteristic of the unique "Shimotsuke-style mounds" of the region. The mound measures approximately 80 meters in length, with the main circular mound measuring 61 meters in diameter. Distinctive finds include rows of cylindrical {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪}} and decorative Haniwa figures, such as weavers, humans, and horses, notable for their excellent preservation, original positions, and traces of paintHistoric Site Explanation Board.. The burial chamber is a tuff-stone {{ill|Yokoana stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室}}, opening southward from the anterior mound. The tumulus is dated to the late 6th century. Artifacts excavated from the mound were designated as Important Cultural Properties of Japan in 2017. The site lies adjacent to the ruins of the {{ill|Shimotsuke Kokubun-ji|ja|下野国分寺跡}} temple complex. == Burial Facility == The burial chamber is constructed from cut tuff stones and is oriented southward from the anterior mound. Although partially destroyed, the chamber's dimensions are estimated as follows: * Total length: 4.2 meters (approximately 9 meters including the burial path). * Main chamber: Length 3.0 meters, Width 2.0 meters, Height 1.9 meters. * Entry passage: Length 0.6 meters. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (Nationally Designated) === * Artifacts excavated from Kabutozuka Kofun, Tochigi Prefecture (archaeological materials). Stored and exhibited at the Shimotsuke Fudoki-no-Oka Museum. Tumulus (central posterior mound, left anterior mound) | group = Shimotsuke Burial Mound Cluster (Iizuka-Kokubunji Area) | location = {{ill|Shimotsuke City|ja|下野市}}, Tochigi Prefecture, Kokubunji 847 | latitude = 36|longitude = 139|latd = 36|latm = 23|lats = 1.80|longd = 139|longm = 48|longs = 18.15 | iso = JP-09 | shape = {{ill|Scallop-shaped burial mound|ja|帆立貝形古墳}} | size = Mound length: 80m | constructed = Late 6th century | burial facility = {{ill|Yokoana stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室}} | deceased = Unknown | artifacts = {{ill|Sue ware|ja|須恵器}}, {{ill|Haji ware|ja|土師器}}, {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪}} | historic site = None | cultural property = Artifacts designated as Important Cultural Property of Japan | map = Japan Tochigi | label = Kabutozuka Kofun | icon = | label_position = top }} == Overview ==

Kabutozuka Kofun is located on a plateau in western {{ill|Shimotsuke City|ja|下野市}}, nestled between the {{ill|Sugata River|ja|姿川}} and {{ill|Omoi River (Tochigi)|ja|思川}}. The area features a cluster of burial mounds, including notable large-scale tumuli such as {{ill|Marishitenzuka Kofun|ja|摩利支天塚古墳}}, {{ill|Biwazuka Kofun|ja|琵琶塚古墳}}, and {{ill|Azuma Kofun|ja|吾妻古墳}}. This mound underwent archaeological investigations during 1883 and 1893 (Meiji 16 and 26), which resulted in significant changes to its original condition. The tumulus is characterized as a scallop-shaped keyhole mound with a short anterior mound facing south. It features a two-tiered mound structure, with the first tier having a flat base characteristic of the unique "Shimotsuke-style mounds" of the region. The mound measures approximately 80 meters in length, with the main circular mound measuring 61 meters in diameter. Distinctive finds include rows of cylindrical {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪}} and decorative Haniwa figures, such as weavers, humans, and horses, notable for their excellent preservation, original positions, and traces of paintHistoric Site Explanation Board.. The burial chamber is a tuff-stone {{ill|Yokoana stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室}}, opening southward from the anterior mound. The tumulus is dated to the late 6th century. Artifacts excavated from the mound were designated as Important Cultural Properties of Japan in 2017. The site lies adjacent to the ruins of the {{ill|Shimotsuke Kokubun-ji|ja|下野国分寺跡}} temple complex. == Burial Facility == The burial chamber is constructed from cut tuff stones and is oriented southward from the anterior mound. Although partially destroyed, the chamber's dimensions are estimated as follows: * Total length: 4.2 meters (approximately 9 meters including the burial path). * Main chamber: Length 3.0 meters, Width 2.0 meters, Height 1.9 meters. * Entry passage: Length 0.6 meters. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (Nationally Designated) === * Artifacts excavated from Kabutozuka Kofun, Tochigi Prefecture (archaeological materials). Stored and exhibited at the Shimotsuke Fudoki-no-Oka Museum. Designated on September 15, 2017Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 117, September 15, 2017.[http://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/2017031002.html Regarding National Treasures and Important Cultural Properties Designation] (Agency for Cultural Affairs).{{National Cultural Property Database|201|00011756|Kabutozuka Kofun Artifacts}}. ** Weaving Haniwa figures (2 items). ** Human-shaped Haniwa (17 items). ** Horse-shaped Haniwa (4 items). ** {{ill|Sue ware|ja|須恵器}} (58 items). ** {{ill|Haji ware|ja|土師器}} (16 items). ** (Supplementary designation): Haniwa fragments (4 items). The area features a cluster of burial mounds, including notable large-scale tumuli such as {{ill|Marishitenzuka Kofun|ja|摩利支天塚古墳}}, {{ill|Biwazuka Kofun|ja|琵琶塚古墳}}, and {{ill|Azuma Kofun|ja|吾妻古墳}}. This mound underwent archaeological investigations during 1883 and 1893 (Meiji 16 and 26), which resulted in significant changes to its original condition. The tumulus is characterized as a scallop-shaped keyhole mound with a short anterior mound facing south. It features a two-tiered mound structure, with the first tier having a flat base characteristic of the unique "Shimotsuke-style mounds" of the region. The mound measures approximately 80 meters in length, with the main circular mound measuring 61 meters in diameter. Distinctive finds include rows of cylindrical {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪}} and decorative Haniwa figures, such as weavers, humans, and horses, notable for their excellent preservation, original positions, and traces of paintHistoric Site Explanation Board.. The burial chamber is a tuff-stone {{ill|Yokoana stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber}}, opening southward from the anterior mound. The tumulus is dated to the late 6th century. Artifacts excavated from the mound were designated as Important Cultural Properties of Japan in 2017. The site lies adjacent to the ruins of the {{ill|Shimotsuke Kokubun-ji|ja|下野国分寺跡}} temple complex. == Burial Facility == The burial chamber is constructed from cut tuff stones and is oriented southward from the anterior mound. Although partially destroyed, the chamber's dimensions are estimated as follows: * Total length: 4.2 meters (approximately 9 meters including the burial path). * Main chamber: Length 3.0 meters, Width 2.0 meters, Height 1.9 meters. * Entry passage: Length 0.6 meters. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (Nationally Designated) === * Artifacts excavated from Kabutozuka Kofun, Tochigi Prefecture (archaeological materials). Stored and exhibited at the Shimotsuke Fudoki-no-Oka Museum. Designated on September 15, 2017Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 117, September 15, 2017.[http://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/2017031002.html Regarding National Treasures and Important Cultural Properties Designation] (Agency for Cultural Affairs).{{National Cultural Property Database|201|00011756|Kabutozuka Kofun Artifacts}}. ** Weaving Haniwa figures (2 items). ** Human-shaped Haniwa (17 items). ** Horse-shaped Haniwa (4 items). ** {{ill|Sue ware|ja|須恵器}} (58 items). ** {{ill|Haji ware|ja|土師器}} (16 items). ** (Supplementary designation): Haniwa fragments (4 items). '''Kabutozuka Kofun''' (甲塚古墳) {{Infobox ancient site | name = Kabutozuka Kofun | image = [[File:Kabutozuka Kofun (Shimotsuke) zenkei.JPG|280px]]
Tumulus (central posterior mound, left anterior mound) | group = Shimotsuke Burial Mound Cluster (Iizuka-Kokubunji Area) | location = {{ill|Shimotsuke City|ja|下野市}}, Tochigi Prefecture, Kokubunji 847 | latitude = 36|longitude = 139|latd = 36|latm = 23|lats = 1.80|longd = 139|longm = 48|longs = 18.15 | iso = JP-09 | shape = {{ill|Scallop-shaped burial mound|ja|帆立貝形古墳}} | size = Mound length: 80m | constructed = Late 6th century | burial facility = {{ill|Yokoana stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber}} | deceased = Unknown | artifacts = {{ill|Sue ware|ja|須恵器}}, {{ill|Haji ware|ja|土師器}}, {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪}} | historic site = None | cultural property = Artifacts designated as Important Cultural Property of Japan | map = Japan Tochigi | label = Kabutozuka Kofun | icon = | label_position = top }} == Overview ==
{| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff;text-align:center;font-size:85%;" |+Shimotsuke Burial Mound Cluster (Iizuka-Kokubunji Area) Summary ! name !! Shape !! Size !! Constructed !! Historic Site Status |- | {{ill|Marishitenzuka Kofun|ja|摩利支天塚古墳}} || {{ill|Keyhole-shaped burial mound|ja|前方後円墳}} || Mound length: 120m || Late 5th century || National Historic Site |- | {{ill|Biwazuka Kofun|ja|琵琶塚古墳}}|| Keyhole-shaped burial mound || Mound length: 123m || Early 6th century || National Historic Site |- | {{ill|Azuma Kofun|ja|吾妻古墳}} || Keyhole-shaped burial mound || Mound length: 128m || Late 6th century || National Historic Site |- | '''Kabutozuka Kofun''' || Scallop-shaped burial mound || Mound length: 80m || Late 6th century || None |- | {{ill|Atagozuka Kofun (Shimotsuke)|ja|愛宕塚古墳 (下野市)}} || Keyhole-shaped burial mound || Mound length: 78.5m || Late 6th century || Prefectural Historic Site |- | {{ill|Sannozuka Kofun (Shimotsuke)|ja|山王塚古墳 (下野市)}} || Keyhole-shaped burial mound || Mound length: 89m || Late 6th–Early 7th century || None |- | {{ill|Marutsuka Kofun (Shimotsuke)|ja|丸塚古墳 (下野市)}} || {{ill|Round burial mound|ja|円墳}} || Diameter: 65m || Early 7th century || Prefectural Historic Site |}
Kabutozuka Kofun is located on a plateau in western {{ill|Shimotsuke City|ja|下野市}}, nestled between the {{ill|Sugata River|ja|姿川}} and {{ill|Omoi River (Tochigi)|ja|思川}}. The area features a cluster of burial mounds, including notable large-scale tumuli such as {{ill|Marishitenzuka Kofun|ja|摩利支天塚古墳}}, {{ill|Biwazuka Kofun|ja|琵琶塚古墳}}, and {{ill|Azuma Kofun|ja|吾妻古墳}}. This mound underwent archaeological investigations during 1883 and 1893 (Meiji 16 and 26), which resulted in significant changes to its original condition. The tumulus is characterized as a scallop-shaped keyhole mound with a short anterior mound facing south. It features a two-tiered mound structure, with the first tier having a flat base characteristic of the unique "Shimotsuke-style mounds" of the region. The mound measures approximately 80 meters in length, with the main circular mound measuring 61 meters in diameter. Distinctive finds include rows of cylindrical {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪}} and decorative Haniwa figures, such as weavers, humans, and horses, notable for their excellent preservation, original positions, and traces of paintHistoric Site Explanation Board.. The burial chamber is a tuff-stone {{ill|Yokoana stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber}}, opening southward from the anterior mound. The tumulus is dated to the late 6th century. Artifacts excavated from the mound were designated as Important Cultural Properties of Japan in 2017. The site lies adjacent to the ruins of the {{ill|Shimotsuke Kokubun-ji|ja|下野国分寺跡}} temple complex. == Burial Facility == The burial chamber is constructed from cut tuff stones and is oriented southward from the anterior mound. Although partially destroyed, the chamber's dimensions are estimated as follows: * Total length: 4.2 meters (approximately 9 meters including the burial path). * Main chamber: Length 3.0 meters, Width 2.0 meters, Height 1.9 meters. * Entry passage: Length 0.6 meters. == Cultural Properties == === Important Cultural Properties (Nationally Designated) === * Artifacts excavated from Kabutozuka Kofun, Tochigi Prefecture (archaeological materials). Stored and exhibited at the Shimotsuke Fudoki-no-Oka Museum. Designated on September 15, 2017Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notification No. 117, September 15, 2017.[http://www.bunka.go.jp/koho_hodo_oshirase/hodohappyo/2017031002.html Regarding National Treasures and Important Cultural Properties Designation] (Agency for Cultural Affairs).{{National Cultural Property Database|201|00011756|Kabutozuka Kofun Artifacts}}. ** Weaving Haniwa figures (2 items). ** Human-shaped Haniwa (17 items). ** Horse-shaped Haniwa (4 items). ** {{ill|Sue ware|ja|須恵器}} (58 items). ** {{ill|Haji ware|ja|土師器}} (16 items). ** (Supplementary designation): Haniwa fragments (4 items). The area features a cluster of burial mounds, including notable large-scale tumuli such as {{ill|Marishitenzuka Kofun|ja|摩利支天塚古墳}}, {{ill|Biwazuka Kofun|ja|琵琶塚古墳}}, and {{ill|Azuma Kofun|ja|吾妻古墳}}. It features a two-tiered mound structure, with the first tier having a flat base characteristic of the unique "Shimotsuke-style mounds" of the region. The mound measures approximately 80 meters in length, with the main circular mound measuring 61 meters in diameter. Distinctive finds include rows of cylindrical {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪}} and decorative Haniwa figures, such as weavers, humans, and horses, notable for their excellent preservation, original positions, and traces of paintHistoric Site Explanation Board.. The burial chamber is a tuff-stone {{ill|Yokoana stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber}}, opening southward from the anterior mound. The tumulus is dated to the late 6th century.
